_comment: Generated by scripts/measure-redaction-corpus.js. Every token is a path-shaped span the 'full' entropy bar destroys and the 'events' profile preserves. The TEXT is synthetic: each token is a class-preserving substitution of a real captured span (same length, same separators, same character classes, entropy preserved-or-raised), because these tests assert shape and nothing reads the text. Do not 'restore' readability here; the readable version leaked internal paths for two releases.
